title: Perfectness of a flat finite-type polynomial quotient
statement: Let $R\to A$ be a flat finite-type homomorphism of commutative Noetherian rings [def-weil-flat-morphism, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and let $P=R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]\twoheadrightarrow A$ be a polynomial presentation. Then $A$, regarded as a $P$-module through the presentation, is a perfect $P$-complex [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]: it admits a bounded resolution by finitely generated projective $P$-modules [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. In addition, $A$ has finite Tor dimension over $R$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude].
